jobs.occupation: Concrete Worker - day work - high salary!
jobs.description:
Job Description:

A concrete manufacturing company specializing in precast concrete products is looking for a Production Worker.

Your responsibilities include:

• Daily production of precast concrete elements

• Pouring concrete into moulds

• Preparing reinforcement structures

• Operating an overhead crane when required

Candidate Profile:

We are looking for a candidate who:

• Has experience in the concrete, construction, or building sector

• Can operate an overhead crane or is willing to learn

• Can communicate in English or Dutch

• Is not afraid of physically demanding and hands-on work

Our client is a well-established transport and maintenance company based in Bilzen (Belgium), specialized in the servicing and repair of trucks, trailers, and commercial vehicles.In this role, you are responsible for the maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of heavy-duty vehicles in a modern and fully equipped workshop. You ensure that all vehicles are delivered in safe and optimal working condition.Your responsibilities include:
• Performing maintenance and repair work on trucks and trailers
• Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues
• Carrying out preventive maintenance and breakdown repairs
• Inspecting vehicles and ensuring road safety standards
• Working with modern diagnostic tools and workshop equipment
• Ensuring high-quality and efficient repair work
• Collaborating with experienced technicians in a professional workshopWorking hours:
• 08:00 – 18:30or
• 10:30 – 18:00 (Mon–Fri) + Saturday 08:00 – 12:00 (depending on schedule)
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on truck mechanic:
• Experience as a truck or trailer mechanic
• Knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, hydraulics, and electrical systems
• Ability to work independently and in a team
• Good level of English
• European nationality
• Category B driving licence (mandatory)
• Category C driving licence is a plus
• Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

Our client is one of the top 3 automotive dealer groups in Belgium, with more than 16,600 new vehicles sold in 2023. The group represents leading brands such as Audi, Volkswagen, Škoda, SEAT, CUPRA, VW Commercial Vehicles, BMW, MINI, Jaguar, and Land Rover.To support their continued growth in the Limburg region, they are currently looking for an experienced Panel Beater with strong skills in vehicle body repair and preparation.In this role, you will work in a modern automotive workshop focused on high-quality body repair and finishing.Your responsibilities include:
• Preparing new parts and repairing dents and body damage
• Working with metal and aluminium components
• Filling, sanding, cleaning, masking, and applying primer
• Operating primer drying systems
• Restoring vehicle body structures through welding, grinding, and panel replacement
• Comparing damaged parts with new components and reporting missing parts
• Transforming damaged components into repairable or new parts
• Performing quality and functionality checks (vehicle readiness, calibration, ADAS systems, etc.)
• Ensuring vehicles are fully prepared and safe for delivery
We are looking for an experienced and skilled automotive body repair professional:
• Minimum 3 years of experience as a panel beater or body repair technician
• Strong knowledge of vehicle body preparation and repair techniques
• Experience with metal and aluminium bodywork
• Ability to perform filling, sanding, masking, and priming
• Experience in welding, grinding, and panel replacement
• Good level of English
• European nationality
• Category B driving licence is a plus👉 If you recognize yourself in this profile, you are the ideal candidate for this position.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
A growing company that packages and stores frozen and chilled food products to order for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where collaboration and job satisfaction are key.

On behalf of our client in Roeselare , Let's Work is looking for a packer of food products.

In this role, you will be responsible for carefully packing various food products in a cool working environment of 5 to 10°C. Together with the line manager and colleagues, you will ensure that every product is packed correctly. You can choose between day shifts from 7.45 am to 3.30 pm or afternoon shifts from 3.45 pm to 11.30 pm.

Do you enjoy playing an active part in a smooth production process and do you have an eye for neat packaging? Then be sure to read on!

What does your working day as a packer look like?

 
• 
You will carefully pack various types of food products in accordance with the prescribed procedures

 
• 
On the packing line, you'll work alongside the line supervisor and colleagues

 
• 
The right products are packaged correctly, with quality always being the top priority

 
• 
Whilst working, you'll be in a cool environment of 5 to 10°C

 
• 
You have gained your first stable work experience as a packer in the food sector

 
• 
Working with precision and an eye for quality characterise your approach

 
• 
Working as part of a team is smooth and enjoyable

 
• 
A flexible attitude comes in very handy

 
• 
For communication in the workplace, you speak good Dutch, English or French; basic English is required

During the busy holiday period in December, extra help is needed for packing products. You will temporarily work in a production environment, making sure everything is packed neatly and quickly so orders can be shipped on time.

A typical workday includes receiving products, checking their quality, and carefully packing them at a brisk pace. You work together with other packers and follow instructions closely. Keeping up the pace is crucial because orders must be ready for timely delivery.

Interested in rolling up your sleeves and helping out during this period? Apply quickly and support the team with your effort and positive attitude!

• Able to work quickly and keep up with a fast pace

• Motivated and committed

• Fluent in Dutch, French, or English

• No experience required

• Available in December for a temporary job

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel - Real Estate & Franchise Law
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading consumer-focused retail organisation operating a large network of company-owned and franchise locations across Belgium and neighbouring markets. With a strong brand portfolio and significant market presence, the business serves a broad customer base through a multi-site retail model.The organisation is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with ongoing investments in operational excellence, digital innovation, store development and franchise expansion. As legal complexity continues to increase, the company is strengthening its in-house legal capabilities to provide closer business support and further reduce reliance on external counsel.The legal team operates as a true business partner, supporting senior management and operational stakeholders across a wide range of legal disciplines. This environment offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise across almost every aspect of commercial law within a dynamic retail setting.The culture is entrepreneurial, pragmatic and commercially driven. Individuals are encouraged to take ownership, challenge constructively and provide practical solutions that enable business growth while appropriately managing legal risk.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the primary legal business partner for the Belgian business units.
• Lead all franchise and commercial real estate matters.
• Advise on franchise development, restructurings and franchise disputes.
• Support commercial lease negotiations, store openings, relocations and property projects.
• Manage negotiations with landlords, franchisees and external stakeholders.
• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements.
• Advise business stakeholders on consumer law, commercial law and day-to-day operational matters.
• Manage material claims, disputes and litigation matters.
• Coordinate and supervise relationships with external law firms.
• Oversee corporate housekeeping activities, including governance documentation, shareholder resolutions, appointments and corporate restructurings.
• Maintain and further develop contract management processes and documentation.
• Participate in multidisciplinary business and transformation projects.
• Support digital, e-commerce, IT, compliance and data protection initiatives.
• Monitor legal and regulatory developments impacting the business.
• Contribute to legal efficiency initiatives and increased internalisation of legal work.

• Master's degree in Belgian Law.
• 8 to 12 years of relevant legal experience.
• Strong expertise in Belgian commercial real estate law.
• Strong expertise in Belgian franchise law.
• Experience within retail, franchise, consumer-facing or multi-site environments.
• Proven experience negotiating leases, franchise agreements and commercial contracts.
• Fluent Dutch and French.
• Professional proficiency in English.
• Ability to operate autonomously and act as a trusted business partner.
• Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• Commercially minded, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.
• Structured, proactive and hands-on personality.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
